notes.title: Official soundtrack available now!
notes.notes:
Hello all!

The official soundtrack of Endless Inside is now available for you all.

The composer, Jan Dolanský made an awesome music themes for the game - it was amazing work together. If you’re developing games or projects that needs a soundtrack, this man will not disappoint you!

Endless Inside official soundtrack - https://jandolansky.bandcamp.com/album/endless-inside-official-soundtrack

Take a look to more songs by Jan Dolanský - https://soundcloud.com/jandolanskymusic

I hope you enjoy, have a great day everyone!

notes.title: Patch notes
notes.notes:
Here you have the list with changes on each patch, if you get a bug let me know and I'll try to solve it ASAP! List will be updated with each patch:

[h1]1.01[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Disappeared and out of place menu buttons for some players is now fixed
[/list]

[h1]1.03[/h1]
[list]
    [*]You will not get more troubles when sometimes phase 4 jumps directly to game over screen
    [*]Due the fixed bug above, extra survive mode now works correctly
[/list]

[h1]1.05[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Responsive time on phase 4 to get the game over screen is now lower
    [*]Phase 5 more easy, time to react is now longer.
[/list]
